prompts.V1:
The attached close-up shows the exact plant to use: every rhododendron in the picture is this same variety — the same lilac-violet flowers (mauve with a pink tint), the same dark glossy leaves, the same dense dome shape with foliage down to the ground, about 1.7 m tall and as wide as it is tall. Use the close-up only for the plant; do not copy its background, soil, trees or framing. No other varieties or colours anywhere (no white, pale pink, magenta or red).
Scene: a rhododendron nursery field in the Netherlands in late May, seen along the row. The camera stands at the end of a nursery row, about 1.2 m above the ground, 85 mm lens. Three large shrubs stand one behind another along a gentle diagonal from the left-centre into the middle distance; more large shrubs of the same variety stand in the next rows to the right, receding and softening with distance. Background: the dark edge of a pine and birch forest (Veluwe) and a thin strip of pale sky. Soft morning side light from the left, a light mist far away.
Every shrub whole inside the frame, none cut off at the left or right edge, no shrub in the extreme foreground. Dark crumbly peat soil in the lower quarter of the frame. Documentary photograph, natural muted colours. No people, no buildings, no machinery, no pots, no text, no watermark.
